0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, 5th in the West) host the Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) on a three-game winning streak, and Minnesota sits second in the Northwest, one game back. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; averaging 33.3 points this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 124-94 road win in Dallas on March 30, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet this season.
